approach: The distance between successive minima gives the wavelength, and the rate at which crests pass the point gives the frequency; their product is the wave speed.

steps.text: Successive minima of a travelling wave are one full wavelength apart.
Find the frequency from the rate at which crests pass the point.

common_mistakes.text: Counting only 4 gaps between the 5 crests and using f = 4/15 Hz, which gives 0.72 m/s and matches no printed option.
